name: Plate Hop
instructions: Stand beside a weight plate on the floor.
Hop laterally over the plate, landing softly on both feet.
Immediately hop back to the start side.
Keep the hops quick and low. A lateral agility and calf drill.
longevityNotes: A stable trunk protects the spine through every decade. Train the core for endurance and control rather than chasing burn.
overview: Plate Hop is a beginner core exercise targeting the calves, performed with minimal equipment. A strong trunk stabilizes every lift and protects the spine in daily life.
